title: The Menagerie
subtitle: A Heatwave, A Chess Game, A New Mystery
summary: Calcutta swelters under an unforgiving summer, and detective Byomkesh Bakshi finds himself bored and restless—until an unexpected visitor interrupts a tense chess match. Behind the oppressive heat and idle days, a new puzzle is about to unfold, promising intrigue and danger. Step into Byomkesh's world, where even the slowest days can spark a captivating mystery.
